title: The groundwater and the aquitard below the profile: aquitard
intro: K aquitard [cm/h]: Conductivity of the aquitard; Z aquitard [cm]: Thickness of the aquitard. The aquitard begins below the bottommost soil horizon. Each is varied from half to double the value the farm uses; K aquitard, Z aquitard moved the yield, water or nitrogen in the test.
